abstract: Two members of a placental alkaline phosphatase (PLAP) family, PLAP and PLAP-like or germ cell alkaline phosphatase, are aberrantly expressed in tumors of ecotropic origin. To characterize alkaline phosphatase induced in seminoma, alkaline phosphatase cDNA clones were isolated from a cDNA library constructed from seminoma cells and characterized by nucleotide sequence determination. Thus, isolated cDNA clones were classified into two types, germ cell alkaline phosphatase (PLAP-like) and liver/bone/kidney-type alkaline phosphatase (L/B/K AP). These results suggest that other than the PLAP family members, the expression of L/B/K AP is enhanced in seminoma and can serve as a tumor marker in seminoma.
abstract_ja: セミノーマで発現するアルカリホスファターゼ遺伝子をcDNAクローニングにより解析した。セミノーマ細胞由来のcDNAライブラリーから単離したcDNAクローンを塩基配列決定により解析し、胚細胞型アルカリホスファターゼ(PLAP様)と肝・骨・腎型アルカリホスファターゼ(L/B/K AP)の2種類に分類した。これらの結果から、PLAPファミリー以外にもL/B/K APの発現がセミノーマで亢進しており、セミノーマの腫瘍マーカーとなりうることが示唆された。
